data.description: Dashboard surfaces for editing the separately versioned SQL-backed shared memory summary and memory protocol, displaying retained important handover notes newest first, and managing optional user lifecycle rules. Note-only memory is visible even when the shared summary is empty. Memory shows optional-write guidance and server-provided retention limits, and external note writes refresh without remounting unchanged summary or protocol editors. Fixed design hook prompts are excluded from the Rules list and edited in Settings.
data.name: Memory and Rules Views
